paper_style.palette_strategy: 模块和照片使用低饱和混合色；蓝/紫/橙区分模型或 evaluator，红/绿表示 failure/success，marker、行列位置、边框和文字提供部分冗余。
paper_style.vector_raster_mix: Figure 1–14 主要由 PDF 嵌入 raster image 渲染；Table 1–5 使用 PDF 矢量文字/规则，公开项目页仅提供若干 raster assets。
paper_style.style_consistency: caption、section heading 和表格规则一致，主文与附录的 grid grammar 稳定；图内 sans-serif 字体、字号、照片色和 legend 密度跨对象有明显差异，Figure 7/10–14 在缩小后可读性下降。

caption.text: Figure 1: dWorldEval is a discrete diffusion world model designed to be controllable and consistent for reliable policy evaluation. figures.label: Figure 2

caption.text: Figure 2: Overview of dWorldEval. (a) Unified architecture: Diverse modalities are flattened into a single sequence, enabling the model to treat visual, control, and semantic tokens uniformly. (b) Sparse keyframe memory: A history of low-resolution keyframes is used to anchor global spatiotemporal consistency. (c) Discrete progress token: The model jointly predicts visual outcomes and discrete progress tokens to enable automatic success detection.

figures.label: Figure 5

caption.text: Figure 5: (a) Action-controllability under suboptimal inputs. We condition all methods on an unseen action sequence and compare their rollouts. While WorldGym [20] self-corrects the missed grasp into a successful pickup and WorldEval [20] hallucinates non-existent objects, Ctrl-World [10] fails to align with the input actions. In contrast, dWorldEval faithfully reproduces the failure. (b) Long-horizon round-trip consistency. We apply a reversible action trajectory: forward actions up to t = H∆, followed by the corresponding inverse actions to t = 2H∆. The full model returns close to the initial observation at t = 0, whereas removing history causes accumulated drift over the round trip.

caption.text: Figure 6: Joint generation enables automatic policy scoring. (a) At each rollout step, the world model jointly predicts the future observation ôt+∆ and a scalar progress score v̂t+∆ ∈ [0, 1], which finally indicates task success or failure. We compare ground-truth execution (Real) against evaluations on generated rollouts: human judgment based on the generated observations (Human) and automatic evaluation determined by the model’s predicted progress score (Auto).

figures.label: Figure 7

caption.text: Figure 7: Correlation between real-execution and world-model success rates. Scatter plots compare real success rates (x-axis) against generated estimates (y-axis), reporting Pearson correlation r and rank-violation MMRV (lower is better). (a) Comparison with video diffusion baselines (WorldEval [20], WorldGym [33] and Ctrl-World [10]) on LIBERO [23] (Single-view). (b-d) Ablation studies comparing dWorldEval against its w/o-history variant across diverse settings: (b) LIBERO (Multi-view), (c) Robotwin [30] with heterogeneous policies (π0 [4], DexVLA [41], DP [6]), and (d) Real-world tasks. dWorldEval consistently achieves superior correlation and ranking accuracy across all domains.

figures.label: Figure 12

caption.text: Figure 12: Qualitative comparison of round-trip consistency with baselines. We visualize the round-trip rollouts (H = 20) on the LIBERO [23] from the shared third-person view. We compare four models: WorldEval [20], WorldGym [33], Ctrl-World [10], dWorldEval (W/O History), and dWorldEval (Full). The goal is to return to the initial state at t = 2H∆ (rightmost column) by executing inverse actions (i.e., reversing the pick-up trajectory to place the object back). Ours (Full) successfully restores the initial scene structure. In contrast, baselines and the w/o-history ablation exhibit significant deviation at the end of the trajectory, caused by a combination of spatiotemporal drift and failure to follow the inverse control signals.

tables.label: Table 1

caption.text: Table 1: Action controllability on LIBERO [23]. Comparison of LPIPS vs. our dynamic-aware ∆LPIPS on Expert (Dsucc) and Failure (Dfail) subsets. Baselines degrade on failure data, while ours remains robust.

tables.uncertainty: 无 mean±spread、error bar、区间、seed 或显著性；只有点均值。
tables.data_and_statistics: LIBERO Expert (Dsucc) 与 Failure (Dfail)：LPIPS 为 WorldEval 0.262、WorldGym 0.218、Ctrl-World 0.220、Ours 0.215；∆LPIPS Expert/Failure 分别为 0.423/0.701、0.347/0.650、0.334/0.416、0.315/0.352。
tables.evidence_relation: §4.2.1 RQ1 → Table 1 action/failure split → Figure 5(a) failure adherence → Appendix Table 5 shuffled-action control。
design_strengths: 静态 LPIPS 和 action-sensitive ∆LPIPS 并置。
Expert/Failure 分组直接暴露 baseline degradation。
design_weaknesses: Dsucc/Dfail 与 dynamic-aware metric 依赖 caption。
点均值无法判断失败分布和差异稳定性。
tables.reusable_pattern: 把静态指标、机制敏感指标和 stress subset 放在同一主表，用方向箭头与行分组突出目标指标。

tables.label: Table 2

caption.text: Table 2: Long-horizon consistency analysis. We report the round-trip LPIPS (↓) error, averaged across all synchronized views, over varying horizons H. Without memory, the model suffers from progressive drift; with memory, spatiotemporal consistency is effectively preserved even at H = 20.

tables.uncertainty: 无重复、seed、spread、区间或显著性；LPIPS 为点均值。
tables.data_and_statistics: round-trip LPIPS (↓)，H=5/10/15/20：W/O Memory 0.177/0.186/0.302/0.411，Full 0.130/0.145/0.193/0.243，平均 synchronized views。
tables.evidence_relation: §4.2.2 RQ2 → Table 2 memory ablation → Figure 5(b) drift → Table 4 baseline horizon → Appendix Figure 12。
design_strengths: 横向 H stress 轴使 drift accumulation 一眼可见。
目标行粗体，表头和精度统一。
design_weaknesses: 只有两行，不能隔离 memory 以外的实现差异。
公开 horizon asset 省略 Table 4 的 Ctrl-World，且无 uncertainty。
tables.reusable_pattern: 把明确 stress variable 放入跨列表头，用 body-row ablation 展示误差随 horizon 累积。

tables.label: Table 3

caption.text: Table 3: Universal multi-view fidelity. Quantitative evaluation across diverse platforms (LIBERO [23], RoboTwin [30], Real-Robot) and synchronized viewpoints. dWorldEval maintains consistent high fidelity (low ∆LPIPS) on both simulation and real-world data.

tables.uncertainty: 无 mean±spread、error bar、seed 或区间；逐 viewpoint 为点均值。
tables.evidence_relation: §4.4 universal fidelity → Table 3 platform×view decomposition → Figure 7 cross-domain ranking → Appendix Figure 13/14 grids。
design_strengths: dataset/viewpoint row groups 清楚。
静态和 dynamic-aware 指标保持同一精度。
design_weaknesses: 不同 domain 的 episode/collection protocol 不在表内。
无 uncertainty，0.01–0.02 差异无法判断稳定性。
tables.reusable_pattern: 把 domain 与 synchronized viewpoint 作为层级行分组，使用同一指标对照跨平台可迁移性。

tables.label: Table 4

caption.text: Table 4: Full consistency comparison. We report the round-trip LPIPS (↓) error averaged over varying horizons H. Comparisons with WorldEval [20], WorldGym [33] and Ctrl-World [10], demonstrate that our model maintains superior spatiotemporal consistency, whereas baselines suffer from significant drift.

tables.uncertainty: 无 uncertainty、seed、分母或显著性；round-trip LPIPS 为点均值。
tables.evidence_relation: Table 2 memory-only ablation → Table 4 cross-baseline horizon → Appendix Figure 12；结果同时受 action adherence 与 temporal drift 影响。
design_strengths: 完整 baseline 行和横向 H 轴使趋势可扫描。
Ours Full 的粗体突出目标。
design_weaknesses: caption 没提醒 metric 也受 action adherence 影响。
公开 horizon asset 缺 Ctrl-World，容易产生不完整复现印象。
tables.reusable_pattern: 在同一表放 baseline、目标模型和多个 horizon，让长程稳定性成为趋势。

tables.label: Table 5

caption.text: Table 5: Action-shuffle sanity check. We permute future action chunks across samples while keeping history and language fixed. Shuffling breaks action–outcome alignment and degrades action-controllability indicators.

tables.uncertainty: 无重复、seed、spread、区间或显著性；仅为 paired point values。
tables.data_and_statistics: Aligned actions 的 LPIPS/∆LPIPS 为 0.215/0.324，Shuffled actions 为 0.461/0.697；history 和 language 固定，future action chunks 在样本间置换。
tables.evidence_relation: Appendix B action permutation → Table 5 complete disruption (p=1) → Figure 9 continuous corruption；检验指标是否依赖 action condition 而非 static appearance。
design_strengths: 最小 paired table 同时呈现静态和机制敏感指标变化。
condition 与方向箭头简洁。
design_weaknesses: 表格窄，condition 与指标方向依赖 caption。
一次汇总值不展示 permutation 随机性的分布。
tables.reusable_pattern: 用最小 paired table 固定 history/language，只改变 action condition，并并列静态与敏感指标。

cross_object_system.visual_narrative: Figure 1/2 先定义 dWorldEval 的四能力和统一 token/memory/progress 接口；Figure 3–5 验证 action controllability 与 temporal consistency，Figure 6–7 接上 progress scoring 和 cross-domain policy ranking；Table 1–4 给出数值锚点，Appendix Figure 8–14 扩展任务、corruption、label/prediction 和 simulation/real qualitative evidence。
cross_object_system.caption_system: caption 以加粗对象标题开始，随后说明 panel/source/condition。Figure 5–7 直接写主发现，Figure 8、10–14 偏设置与定性说明；Figure 12 的 “four models” 与五个列举不一致。
cross_object_system.table_header_system: 表格使用短指标名和方向箭头；Action Horizon 采用跨列二层表头，dataset/condition 用 row groups；主文三位小数统一，未设置 uncertainty header。
cross_object_system.method_result_ablation_link: unified tokens 对应 Table 1、Figure 4–5(a)、Table 5；sparse keyframe memory 对应 Table 2、Figure 5(b)、Table 4、Figure 12；progress token 对应 Figure 6、10、11；action corruption/∆LPIPS 对应 Figure 9、Table 5。
cross_object_system.main_appendix_link: §4.1 由 Figure 3 延伸到 Figure 8/13/14 的平台、任务和多视角样例；§4.2.1/4.2.2 由 Table 1/2、Figure 5 延伸到 Appendix Figure 9、Table 5、Figure 12；§4.2.3 的 progress claim 由 Figure 6 延伸到 Figure 10/11；§4.4 的 fidelity/consistency 由 Table 3/4 延伸到 Figure 13/14。
cross_object_system.typography_consistency: 正文和表格保持 SFRM/Computer Modern 体系，嵌入图像使用 Byte Sans/Arial-like sans 与 Computer Modern math；caption/table hierarchy 清晰，但图内字号和 inset/legend 密度不完全统一。
cross_object_system.color_consistency: 蓝/紫/橙反复表示 evaluator、source 或 score，红/绿反复表示 failure/success；照片原色在 Figure 3–5、8、12–14 中占主导，不能将所有对象的颜色当作同一数值 palette。

most_reusable_patterns: 用 Figure 1/2 的 overview 把输入、memory、联合输出和 evaluator interface 固定到同一视觉坐标系，再以独立图表验证组件。
用 scenario×source 或 model×time 的稳定 grid 组织多视角 robot rollout，使真实/生成、成功/失败和 forward/inverse 维度正交。
用短表头、方向箭头、统一精度、粗体目标行和连续 corruption sweep，把 LPIPS/∆LPIPS、horizon、action shuffle 变成可扫描的机制证据。
failure_patterns: 项目页有 direct relation 和若干 rendered assets，但没有完整绘图/表格生成源。
自动 inventory 将 19 个 PDF 对象误记为 reading-only；必须以逐页 PDF 为准。
图表普遍不展示 uncertainty、seed 和样本数；Figure 7 legend 密集，Figure 10–14 照片缩小后细节弱。
Figure 12 caption 的模型计数与列举不一致；horizon.png 不能覆盖 PDF Table 4 的 Ctrl-World。
final_judgment.one_sentence_visual_strategy: dWorldEval 采用“统一 token/memory/progress 机制图 → action/consistency 定量与定性 stress test → progress/ranking 跨域验证 → 模拟/真实多视角附录”的闭环，主张世界模型必须遵循动作、保持时间结构并支持可排序的 policy 评估。
